name: Do I need special flooring or waterproofing for a curbless shower?

mainEntity.name: Do I need special flooring or waterproofing for a curbless shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, special attention to flooring and waterproofing is crucial for a curbless shower. The subfloor within the shower area must be precisely sloped to direct water towards the drain, preventing pooling and overflow into the main bathroom. A robust, continuous waterproofing membrane is then applied over the entire shower pan and up the walls to code-specified heights. This is essential to prevent water damage to your home's structure. Specialized drainage systems are also often integrated to manage water effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, proper subfloor sloping and a robust, continuous waterproofing membrane are crucial for a functional and leak-free curbless shower.
